notes: Prices in JPY from SNKRDUNK. This is run6, a next-day follow-up to run5 (2026-09-16 ~18:26 JST) collected via the built-in browser pane (Claude in Chrome extension was not connected this run) at an 800x600 viewport. Listings filtered to 販売中のみ (for-sale only); top-20 cheapest active listings taken per grade, with a 15% cutoff above the lowest listing (threshold = lowest * 1.15) splitting them into within_15pct vs excluded_over_15pct. The site's 安い順 (cheapest-first) sort was applied via the JS native-setter workaround and verified via SCREENSHOT (not get_page_text) before extracting the top 20, per the lesson learned in run5 (get_page_text cannot detect the 'SOLD' overlay badge on listing tiles) - no such issue occurred this run. recent_completed_sales are the most recent ~15-20 sales-history entries per grade, oldest-to-newest, filtered by the 状態 grade pill on the card's 売買履歴 section. PSA10 population/gem-rate sourced from altema.jp (pokekachi) for the 5 established cards, all re-verified unchanged from run5 (10846/88.0%, 20026/88.7%, 80321/86.9%, 8102/81.5%, 49275/86.6%). image_url reused from the skill's cached table for all 11 cards (no re-fetching needed). All 6 M6a '30th CELEBRATION' cards (released 2026-09-16) still have zero PSA10 listings/sales and no altema.jp PSA10 population data one day after release - PSA grading turnaround takes weeks, so this is expected. Two of the six M6a cards now show early higher-grading-tier activity for the first time: Card 8 (ジラーチex SAR) has a new BGS9.5 listing at ¥4,900~ (was 出品待ち in run5), and Card 11 (ピカチュウex SAR, night) has a new PSA9 listing at ¥10,500~ (was 出品待ち in run5) - both are the first non-A/B grading-related listings seen for these cards, though PSA10 remains empty for all six. Their A-grade markets remain extremely active on day 2 post-release, with recent sales-history turnover in the minutes-to-hours-old range across all 6 cards (versus single-digit-minutes on release day itself in run4). Notable findings vs run5 (collected the prior day, 2026-09-16 ~18:26 JST): (1) Card 3 (ブラッキーex SAR, Umbreon ex) PSA10 lowest listing has risen from ¥64,000 to ¥68,000 - a genuine ~6% increase, with one obvious joke/deterrent listing at ¥10,000,000 correctly excluded from the top-20 stats. (2) Card 4 (ゲンガーVMAX SA) PSA10 lowest listing has dropped further, from ¥293,000 (run5) to ¥285,000 now - the sharp multi-week downward trend identified in run5 (from a ~¥380-400k range in early September) is continuing; altema.jp's cached PSA10相場 (¥320,000, still dated 2026/9/15) has not caught up with this drop, corroborating it as a genuine recent move rather than a data artifact. (3) Card 5 (名探偵ピカチュウ プロモ) A-grade price has held steady in the ¥26,500-28,000 cluster that run5 identified as a recent drop from the ~¥35,000-38,500 range in early September, with continued sales confirming the new lower level has stabilized rather than being a one-off dip. (4) pokeca-chart.com index data_range has genuinely advanced to 2026/09/16 (from run5's 2026/09/15), as expected since this run occurred on a new calendar day - PSA10 index now at ¥115,636 (day -1.8%, month -23.2%, year +21.4%), raw/美品 index at ¥52,303 (day -0.1%, month -3.8%, year +29.8%); both trailing-month transaction-volume trends remain flat with no unusual spikes. psa_tier_status omitted this run (JST is Thursday, not Monday; the weekly PSA Value-tier check runs Mondays only).
